To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) note taking is a dynamic and interactive process, (2) the process of note making and note taking is closely connected with interpreting process, (3) note taking strategies can be identified by observing note making process and note taking behaviour, and (4) note taking strategies and note taking behaviours can be linked with interpreting performance and interpreting strategies.

(a) the unparalleled nature of notes, which is caused by information selection, grammatical focus and note quantity, is the most prominent feature of note taking; (b) ear pen span, which is the time lag between ST input and NT, is the most important factor in determining the unparalleled nature of note taking; and (c) the unparalleled nature is the most prominent factor in determining the efficiency of notes.
